diagnostics.message: Uploading aws_s3_object.trigger during apply invokes the syncer Lambda via the S3 bucket notification (the object's key matches the notification's "triggers/*.json" filter), but nothing orders this invocation after aws_cloudwatch_log_group.syncer is created. The log group only depends on the Lambda (via its function_name), so it is a sibling of the trigger object rather than a predecessor. If the trigger fires the Lambda first, Lambda auto-creates the default log group without the configured retention_in_days/kms_key_id, causing Terraform's log group creation to fail with "log group already exists" or drift. Add depends_on = [aws_cloudwatch_log_group.syncer] to aws_s3_object.trigger.
